subject: science
prompt:
# The Problem With Being Good At Something

Proto has a membrane, a wall, compartments and a working set of departments. It is, by the standards of the ancient ocean, extremely successful.

> **And then it dies. What was the point of any of it?**

Say what you think has to survive, if the cell itself does not.

options.text: Nothing survives. Each cell has to solve everything again from scratch.
options.feedback: If that were true, nothing would ever have got more complicated than the first cell.

options.text: The instructions for building a cell like that one.
The cell's organelles, passed on to a neighbour.
options.feedback: Parts wear out. What has to persist is more durable than any part.
Nothing here remembers anything. But you are close - something IS being carried forward.
